review_limitations: Every pinned Oracle paragraph of every member, including both transform faces, is enumerated below.

power_up.requires: Exact source-incarnation activation allowances; mana-symbol subtraction only on the turn the permanent entered; generic/shared reductions; X, hybrid and colorless costs; Wonder Man extra allowance; Hulk other-creature discount; Kang extra-turn prohibition.

teamwork.requires: Optional cast additional cost; simultaneous tap selection with total effective power threshold; summoning-sick creatures allowed; paid historical cast flag; choose modes and targets from that flag; Maria Hill taps-for-teamwork trigger; Captain America untap triggers never undo the paid flag.

plan_threshold.requires: Plan counters; historical crossing before < threshold <= after, including entry counters; retain trigger if counters later removed; mandatory exact-source sacrifice; separate reflexive packet only on actual sacrifice where printed; entry/counter replacement and multiple crossings.

keyword_counters.requires: Persistent counter kinds grant appropriate layer-6 keywords; removal, suppression, source changes and characteristic/funding queries; include all eleven Super-Adaptoid kinds.

shield_counter.requires: Shield storage; prevent damage while removing exactly one shield counter; unpreventable damage removes a shield but remains dealt; destroy replacement; no replacement for sacrifice/toughness SBA; conditional player and other-Hero hexproof.

finality_counter.requires: Global exact-object death-to-exile replacement independent of printed abilities; no dies trigger; replacement order; returned creature enters with counter; clear on zone change.

invasion_counter.requires: Invasion counter storage; resolve Alien Invasion count from source/LKI; put counters on all created token objects; then increment only unchanged live source.

counter_history.requires: Track which exact creatures were given +1/+1 counters by the controller this turn; per-object and one-or-more batch history must follow wording; source-only/other-only and optional-once semantics.

controlled_player_turn.requires: Next-turn player control changes decision authority and access to every hidden fact that controlled player can see; legality, public/private observations and owned branch state; does not transfer battlefield controllers.

double_faced_transform.requires: Five modal double-faced physical card pairs: either face may be cast normally, with selected-face cost, characteristics, mana value and flash/timing legality. Front faces additionally have printed transform activations retaining exact identity/counters/control/attachments. Reenter normally as front face; optional Nick Fury transformation happens after front-face entry during resolution.

copy_effect.requires: Distinguish copied spells/abilities, copied card objects, token copies and copying existing permanents; nonlegendary/name/type/stat/ability exceptions and expiration/source dependence; legal retargeting and copied X/modes.

restricted_mana.requires: Track individual mana restrictions through funding; Hero/Villain casts and source activations, creature abilities, equip abilities or Equipment casts, artifact-only vs cannot-cast-nonartifact; no illicit generic reassignment.

improvise.requires: Tap controlled untapped artifacts only for generic spell costs after mana ability activation; do not double-spend shared tapped sources; Ironheart grants improvise only to noncreature spells.

sneak.requires: Alternative spell cost only declare-blockers step after blocking, returning unblocked attacker; spell enters tapped attacking; transactional choice/payment and receiving attack player.

harness.requires: Exact-permanent harnessed designation survives control and ability loss; reset on zone change; repeat activations legal; layer-6 ability grant only while harnessed.

pregame_action.requires: Opening-hand optional reveal/begin-on-battlefield action for Quicksilver; pregame hand/privacy/order, initial entry timing, starting-player choices and subsequent power-up entry-turn qualification.

attack_alone_observer.requires: Observe any controlled creature attacking alone, freeze its exact identity and correct defending player; trigger event qualification rather than later combat count.

generic_card_translation.requires: Write or audit the whole typed definition against every Oracle paragraph and complete Java references; implement any uncovered predicate/choice/effect; do not infer complete behavior from existing primitives.

inherited_admission_audit.requires: Compare all inherited typed programs with complete current Oracle faces and Java references and locate actual per-obligation interaction tests; admission flags and migrated provenance are not certification.

xmage_source_absent.requires: Pinned XMage revision has no implementation for this Oracle identity. Use complete Oracle/rulings as primary evidence, record source absence, and obtain explicit independent rules reviews; never invent a Java source path/hash.

one_or_more_event_batches.requires: Observe one whole simultaneous batch, not a separate trigger per object; retain source/controller/recipient/type/placing-player facts from event.
